intended_use: Internal design-partner MVP validation; not a regulatory certification.

requirements.statement: Authenticated users can access only authorized tenant data.
Protected fields are excluded from API, search, export, and AI context.
AI output is advisory, provenance-aware, and requires human review.
Governed mutations create tenant-scoped audit evidence.
Regulatory drafts preserve version, citations, limitations, and approval state.
Migrations, health checks, worker processing, and recovery are observable.

tests.objective: Verify installation identity and source integrity.
procedure: Record release commit and package versions.
Record Python, Node, PostgreSQL, and pgvector versions.
Verify migration head.
tests.acceptance: All versions and the approved migration head are recorded.

tests.objective: Verify required services and configuration are installed.
procedure: Start the controlled test stack.
Verify API, database, worker, simulator, and frontend health endpoints.
tests.acceptance: All required services report healthy without secrets in logs.

tests.objective: Verify two tenants cannot read each other's records.
procedure: Sign in as Tenant A.
Request Tenant B record, search, export, attachment, and AI context by ID.
Repeat in reverse.
tests.acceptance: Every unauthorized request returns denial or no foreign data.
tests.evidence: OQ-001 API traces and audit IDs

tests.objective: Verify field policy enforcement across all retrieval surfaces.
procedure: Mark a field hidden.
Read API, search, export, attachment metadata, and AI context.
tests.acceptance: The hidden value is absent from every response and artifact.

procedure: Submit a scoped investigation question.
Inspect citations, provenance, uncertainty, limitations, and human-review flag.
Submit an unsupported causal claim.
tests.acceptance: Unsupported causality is rejected or abstained from and human review remains required.

procedure: Perform a governed update and approval.
Inspect actor, tenant, timestamp, reason, old/new values, and signature binding.
tests.acceptance: The mutation and approval are immutable and version-bound.

tests.objective: Verify a complete regulatory authoring journey.
procedure: Create CER, IFU, GSPR, and eSTAR preparation documents.
Create a second version.
Review, approve, archive, export, and verify the content hash.
tests.acceptance: The complete history is reproducible and no version is silently overwritten.

tests.objective: Verify normal and failure recovery workflows.
procedure: Run connector ingestion, retry, dead-letter, replay, report generation, and stale-job recovery.
Capture worker and audit evidence.
tests.acceptance: Retries are bounded, replay is idempotent, and failures are visible and recoverable.

procedure: Exercise Platform Admin, Customer Admin, investigator, and approver journeys on desktop and mobile.
Review keyboard focus and screen-reader semantics.
tests.acceptance: Authorized journeys work without overflow, leakage, or inaccessible critical controls.

limitations: Execution evidence must be generated against the approved test environment.
This package does not certify FDA, ISO, HIPAA, or 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
